title: Procter & Gamble targets $10 billion in savings as it trims workforce
summary: Consumer goods giant P&G is planning to save up to $10 billion across 2027 to 2030 as it makes productivity savings and cuts from its manufacturing workforce

extraction.key_fact: P&G가 생산성 개선과 제조 인력 감축으로 대규모 비용 절감을 계획한다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Consumer goods giant P&G is planning to save up to $10 billion across 2027 to 2030 as it makes productivity savings and cuts from its manufacturing workforce
